notes: Native mode locks a stalled switch choice until transfer and advances fairness only on transfer. Explicit legacy mode preserves frozen PyOCN RTL behavior.
Native ring output candidates are filtered by registered available credit for their routed VC; no selected-ready feedback is introduced.

The intermediate native Ring6 failure was a complete clockwise VC1 credit cycle, with all arbiter locks clear and local ejection credits available. The legacy tested schedule passed. Normalizing new native injections to physical VC0 fixes this case; an internal bit restores original public VC tag OR dateline rewrite at ejection.

Native Ring injection capacity/timing changes to sharing the two physical VC0 credits. Public message width and field contents are unchanged. VCS=2 and CREDITS=2 remain the only ring profile; incoming VC2/3 are rejected.

RTL legacy profiles compare all raw bits, including invalid messages. Synthesized legacy profiles compare every cycle of ready/valid and every valid message, including stalls. Unreset empty/boundary queue invalid data may be optimized; strict invalid-bit comparison failed at Mesh cycle 28 and is retained as a limitation, not counted as a raw-equivalence pass.

The historical bench raw_bits_per_cycle field is omitted for native/conditional comparisons in this evidence; only strict legacy RTL has a fixed all-bits count. Native uses independent identity/content/count/per-original-VC order/dateline and stall/reset checks.

Early RTL and native-netlist builds precede the explicit synthesized-invalid-message comparison option and diagnostic print additions; those changes are inactive in those configurations and leave their checked behavior unchanged. The final Mesh2x2 latency1 legacy RTL bench was also rebuilt with strict invalid-bit comparison enabled.
Protocol violation guards are RTL simulation diagnostics, not synthesized hardware recovery. Endpoints and links must reset together; no epoch protocol exists.

Six actual emitted Mesh/Ring netlists were reread, checked for zero structural errors and zero SCCs, and simulated with the public-interface traffic bench. This is not proof for arbitrary networks or adversarial infinite traffic.

Independent native multi-CGRA mesh/ring programs, standalone ring-control native/legacy, original raw NoC and asymmetric/DMA memory regressions passed. The broader full-current-source refresh remains a separate task.
No original Python source or frozen historical reference was changed. Verilator RTL optimization is enabled; CXXFLAGS=-O0 controls only generated C++ compilation.
